`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none
module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;
generate
if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast
    wire [15:0] gv;
    wire [15:0] ge;
    wire [15:0] gw;
    wire [255:0] lw;
    wire [3:0] lc [0:15];
    wire [15:0] low_term [0:3];
    wire [15:0] high_term [0:3];
    genvar g, j, b;
    for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g+1) begin : groups
        assign gv[g] = |input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
        if (g == 15) begin : top
            assign ge[g] = 1'b1;
        end else begin : lower
            assign ge[g] = ~(|gv[15:g+1]);
        end
        assign gw[g] = gv[g] & ge[g];
        for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j+1) begin : bits_in_group
            if (j == 15) begin : top
                assign lw[g*16+j] = input_unencoded[g*16+j];
            end else begin : lower
                assign lw[g*16+j] = input_unencoded[g*16+j] &
                    ~(|input_unencoded[g*16+15:g*16+j+1]);
            end
            if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : default_bit
                assign output_unencoded[0] = ge[0] &
                    ~(|input_unencoded[15:1]);
            end else begin : ordinary_bit
                assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] = ge[g] & lw[g*16+j];
            end
        end
        assign lc[g][0] = |(lw[g*16 +: 16] & 16'haaaa);
        assign lc[g][1] = |(lw[g*16 +: 16] & 16'hcccc);
        assign lc[g][2] = |(lw[g*16 +: 16] & 16'hf0f0);
        assign lc[g][3] = |input_unencoded[g*16+15:g*16+8];
        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b+1) begin : terms
            assign low_term[b][g] = ge[g] & lc[g][b];
            if ((g & (1 << b)) != 0) begin : selected
                assign high_term[b][g] = gw[g];
            end else begin : unselected
                assign high_term[b][g] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end
    for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b+1) begin : encode
        assign output_encoded[b] = |low_term[b];
        assign output_encoded[b+4] = |high_term[b];
    end
    assign output_valid = |gv;
end else begin : original_behavior
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
    genvar l, n;
    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n+1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin : high
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end
    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l+1) begin : loop_levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n+1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:n*2*l]} :
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin : high
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:n*2*l]};
            end
        end
    end
    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
end
endgenerate
endmodule
`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline serializes hierarchical priority encoding and a high-fanout encoded-to-one-hot decode. Its reported critical paths terminate at decoded outputs after priority selection, buffering, and decode gates.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize the requested instance into sixteen 16-bit groups. Compute local winners and higher-group exclusion in parallel, drive one-hot outputs directly, and form the encoded result using grouped masked reductions instead of a global mux tree followed by a decoder.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival by removing the encode/decode dependency from all 256 one-hot outputs. The encoded reduction network may become critical. No mapped candidate measurements are available, so a numerical improvement or electrical-clean result is not claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds explicit local winner and group-exclusion logic while eliminating the global one-hot decoder. Shared reductions should limit duplication, but mapped area, the 8862.124480 um^2 cap, and electrical limits require verification in the stated flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For WIDTH=256 and MSB priority, every nonzero input selects its highest asserted bit. The zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=1, matching the original ungated default. Ports, parameter defaults, and the LEVELS and W parameters are retained. Other parameter configurations use the original implementation, including its padding, priority, widths, truncations, and default behavior. The design is entirely combinational."
}
